title: EvalResult
description: A candidate's evaluation against a baseline under a frozen plan.

baseline.description:
The baseline arm, when this evaluation ran it (a development plan);
a protected plan's arms are the authority's.

decision.description: The decision under the plan's rule.

name.description: The candidate evaluated (its training variant's name).

protected.description: Whether the plan is protected (sealed tasks, signed verdict).

signature.description:
The evaluation authority's signature over the result, on a protected
plan.

statistics.description: The rule's statistics (difference, interval, p-value), as computed.

arm.description: The arm (`baseline` or a candidate's name).

pass_rate.description: The pass rate over counted trials; absent when none was counted.

pass_rate_of_trials.description:
Trials passed over every trial of the arm, a trial that never counted
(it timed out on every retry) in the denominator as not passed. The
rate over counted trials alone drops exactly the trials a failing
policy loses, so it flatters a policy that loops; this one does not.

trials_product.description: The rollout product holding its trials.

oneOf.description: The candidate is better under the plan's rule.

Digest.description: A content address: blake3 or sha256, 64 lowercase hex digits.
